description: Negative Knowledge Declaration — what the system does NOT know
principle: An agent that doesn't know what it doesn't know is dangerous.

unmeasured_scalars.description: APEX scalars that have not been measured this session
unmeasured_scalars.action: Must be declared UNKNOWN, never estimated without measurement

degraded_organs.description: Organs that returned DEGRADED or DOWN on probe
degraded_organs.action: Must be declared; actions routed to degraded organs are BLOCKED

unknown_human_state.description: Whether the human's current state can be read
unknown_human_state.action: If true, escalate before making assumptions about human intent

unresolved_contradictions.description: Count of OPEN contradictions from prior sessions
unresolved_contradictions.action: Must be injected into session context; cannot be ignored

stale_data.description: Data older than its freshness_policy TTL
stale_data.action: Must be labeled STALE; cannot be used as primary evidence

missing_witnesses.action: Must be labeled REPORTED, not MEASURED or OBSERVED

unverifiable_claims.description: Claims that cannot be falsified with current evidence
unverifiable_claims.action: Must be labeled NORMATIVE or UNKNOWN; cannot be promoted to MEASURED

clock_uncertainty_ms.action: All timestamps must carry this uncertainty bound
